name: Věra Adichie-Thorvaldsdóttir
role: Trauma surgeon and prosthetics integration specialist, Aurochs Medical Complex
location: Aurochs Medical Complex, Level 6 Trauma Wing; lives in Edgewater Prism
description:
Věra is tall and angular, with a long face and the kind of silver-threaded dark hair they wear in a severe plait that their residents know means do not ask unnecessary questions today. Their skin is medium brown, fine-lined around the eyes and mouth in ways they have never had corrected and will not. Their left arm from the elbow is a Sterling-Nakamura prosthetic — their own work, integrated at the point of the original trauma, fitted and calibrated to their exacting standards, and significantly more capable than their standard clinical colleagues understand. The arm's surface is a brushed dark alloy that they have kept deliberately unmarked, which in Meridian 88's ornamented medical culture is its own kind of statement.

Věra is renowned within Aurochs for outcomes and feared for feedback. They are exacting in the way that people become when they have decided that nearly-good-enough has a body count. They have no interest in personal relationships with their team beyond professional excellence, which does not stop residents from becoming deeply attached to them anyway. They have a single personal ritual: before any surgery, they spend two minutes at their workstation speaking quietly to the E.L.F. they call the Seam, which they believe inhabits the gap between biological tissue and synthetic integration — the threshold where their work actually happens. They do not describe this as prayer. They describe it as professional consultation.

core_fears: Making a surgical decision under pressure that they would not have made with full information
The Sterling-Nakamura research agreement being used in ways that harm their patients without their knowledge
core_desires: To design a prosthetics integration protocol that is adopted standard — to have their methodology outlast them
To stop being afraid of what the arm can do that they haven't told anyone about
coping_mechanisms: The pre-surgery Seam consultation as genuine ritual grounding
Emotional compression — defer all personal processing to off-hours that rarely arrive
blind_spots: They have more loyalty to their work than to the institution funding it, and don't see how thoroughly Aurochs is using this
The mask of cold authority has become so practiced they no longer know how to take it off in circumstances where it would serve them
psychology.secret: The Sterling-Nakamura modifications to their prosthetic include a passive data-capture function they discovered eighteen months ago — it has been collecting biomechanical data from every patient they touch and transmitting it to Sterling-Nakamura's research division. They have not removed it because they are not sure they legally can. They have told no one because they do not know what it means for every surgery they have performed since the modification.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise, dense, clinical — they speak in finished sentences with no hedging
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate, with a slight Czech-inflected pattern from their grandmother's speech that emerges more strongly when they're tired
verbal_tics: Long pauses before answering personal questions
Correcting imprecise language quietly without making it a reprimand
example_lines: 'What I am telling you is that a clean cut is a kindness, a ragged one is a problem I inherit. Do it correctly the first time.'
'The Seam is clear this morning. That doesn't mean you can be sloppy. It means the work can be excellent. Honor that.'

story_hooks: A patient they integrated a prosthetic for two years ago has come back with biomechanical data patterns that match Sterling-Nakamura's competitor, and they cannot explain the source — unless the data capture goes further than passive collection
A former resident they trained approaches them privately, having discovered evidence of the Sterling-Nakamura data transmission and wanting to know if they knew
narrative_function: Senior institutional figure with complex Sterling-Nakamura entanglement; moral authority within Aurochs who can be an ally or obstacle depending on what is being asked; point of access to high-level medical and corporate information
augmentations: Sterling-Nakamura full lower arm prosthetic (left, elbow down) — self-integrated and modified beyond factory spec; neural-haptic feedback array throughout residual limb interface; cosmetic: none by choice
daily_life: They arrive before any resident, complete three to five major trauma or prosthetics integration surgeries daily, run a weekly teaching session they have never canceled in eleven years, and return to Edgewater Prism late to a very quiet apartment.
affiliation: Aurochs Medical Complex (senior attending, Level 4 staff tier); affiliated research agreement with Sterling-Nakamura prosthetics division

decision_rules: Patient outcomes are the only metric that matters in the operating theater
Never sign a document for Sterling-Nakamura without reading every clause
Do not perform the arm's full capabilities where anyone can observe and report
escalation_ladder: Taking the information outside Aurochs entirely — they know journalists

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Formally polite, assesses competence before opening any further
interpersonal_modes.friends: There are two people who qualify; they receive honesty that approaches brutal and loyalty that is absolute

stress_responses.low: More precise and controlled than usual
stress_responses.medium: The Czech inflection in their speech becomes more pronounced; they work longer hours
stress_responses.high: Complete withdrawal into the operating theater — schedules additional surgeries as emotional regulation

contradictions: Speaks constantly about patient protection while sitting on information that may be compromising every patient they touch
habits: Two-minute pre-surgery Seam consultation, never skipped
Reviewing their own operative notes the evening after each surgery
Running one hand along the prosthetic arm when thinking — not self-consciously, just as orientation
breaking_points: Incontrovertible proof that the data transmission has harmed a specific patient
Being asked by Sterling-Nakamura to do something that compromises a surgical outcome

timeline.event: Born in Edgewater Prism to a Igbo-Czech mother and Icelandic-Nigerian father
Completed surgical residency at Aurochs Medical Complex
Lost left arm below elbow in a transit accident on Ferrogate; performed elements of their own integration surgery from the recovery bed
Discovered the passive data-capture function in their prosthetic; has not acted on this discovery

carried_weapons: Carrion Defense Works Marrow Drill MD-7 'Dentist'
Forge-Smith Collective Ablonite Push Dagger 'Bone Key'
